recalls.summary: Undeclared peanut cross-contact detected on packaging line B for specified lot codes.
Center harness latch may release under sudden braking; free repair kit or refund available.
Included dosing cup prints blurred milliliter markings on affected batches.
Lithium cell pack may overheat during overnight charging on early production lots.
Upper handle weld can loosen after repeated boiling cycles.
Routine quality sampling flagged potential Salmonella contamination in two lots.
Encased corner magnet may detach if dropped onto tile flooring.
Trace dairy protein found in cinnamon seasoning blend for September run.
Molded seam may split under prolonged chewing.
Nozzle seal may lose pressure prematurely; no safety injury reported.
Plastic basket lock tab may crack after high-heat use.
Incomplete heat seal may cause premature spoilage.
Decorative fabric button may detach with repeated pulling.
Sesame seed inclusion omitted from ingredient panel on two lots.
Outer decorative coating may peel after dishwasher cycles.
Pinholes in blister backing may expose lozenges to humidity.
External 12V brick may arc when plugged into loose wall outlets.
Small blue food-grade liner fragments found in one packaging shift.
Lower stainless steel shaft collar may loosen during prolonged blending of hot liquids.
Undeclared sesame allergen detected in single production run.

history.note: All affected jars removed from retail
